title: FIRST DEFENDER TO WIN THE GOLDEN BOY SINCE 2018, AND HE'S 19
description:
Defenders almost never win this one. Pau Cubarsí just did.

Pau Cubarsí is nineteen, and he's taken the Golden Boy from Désiré Doué. The last defender to win it was Matthijs de Ligt in 2018. That's eight years of scouts watching only the goals.

Barcelona now have four winners in six years: Pedri, Gavi, Yamal and Cubarsí. This year he also won LaLiga and the World Cup with Spain, then finished twelfth in the Ballon d'Or as the top defender. Most defenders get a handshake. He got a trophy.

So tell us: is it about time a defender won it, or will it always be the goals that decide this award? Pick a side in the comments.
